newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates ease to 7.75-8.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates ease to 7.75-8.00 percent.

text.p: Jordan overnight dinar rates eased slightly to a 7.75-8.00 percent range on Thursday from 8.00-8.50 percent on Wednesday despite a persistent fund shortage, dealers said.
They said the continued shortage since Saturday was due to liquidity absorbed after the last 15 million dinar CD auction and only a few maturing CDs returning to the market.
Ample liquidity sent rates tumbling to a low 3.00 percent average last week.
